caption: The drawing depicts a full-length dress with a wide, bell-shaped skirt and long, puffed sleeves. The dress is illustrated in a muted gray with vertical panels that feature a repeating vertical pattern of green oval motifs edged by narrow green lines. The bodice is fitted and has a high neckline with a round, lace-trimmed collar and a brooch at the center front. The sleeves are gathered in three distinct puffs and end in ruffled cuffs adorned with green trimmed details. The skirt is voluminous and features the same green patterned stripes as the bodice. The hem of the skirt is trimmed with a ruffled border matching the color and pattern of the dress. The drawing, executed in ink and watercolor, shows some areas of mixed shading likely to indicate fabric texture or shadows. Next to the dress, there is a small rectangular swatch showing a close-up of the dress’s fabric pattern, featuring the same alternating gray and patterned green stripes. There is no face or body depicted, only the outline of the dress and hands, with the background left plain.
title: Dress
